Definition: of Latin origin; "second"; Secundus, a Christian:--Secundus.
BiblicalUsage: Secundus is named once, among the companions who travelled with Paul into Asia. Of the Thessalonians came Aristarchus and Secundus, with Gaius, and Timotheus, and Tychicus and Trophimus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the companions matter because Paul never travelled alone — the gospel moved in company, and Secundus walked in it.
